url: http://localhost:4173/
---

# Deleting a todo removes it and updates the counter

## Add two todos
Open http://localhost:4173/. Add a todo "Buy milk", then add a todo "Walk the dog". Verify both "Buy milk" and "Walk the dog" are visible in the todo list and the footer counter reads exactly "2 items left".

## Delete one todo
Hover over the "Buy milk" todo and click its delete (×) button. Verify exactly one todo is listed and it is "Walk the dog", "Buy milk" is no longer visible anywhere in the list, and the footer counter reads exactly "1 item left".

## Clear a completed todo
Tick the checkbox next to "Walk the dog", then click "Clear completed". Verify the todo list is empty, "Walk the dog" is no longer visible, and the footer with the item counter is no longer shown.
